_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); railroad signals

pit_profile.why: Union Pacific: the largest railroad in North America, covering 23 states across the western two-thirds of the US, with BNSF its main rail competitor on parallel routes; carload volume follows the industrial economy, the franchise does not

classification.quality_note: Union Pacific: the largest railroad in North America, covering 23 states across the western two-thirds of the US, with BNSF its main rail competitor on parallel routes; carload volume follows the industrial economy, the franchise does not. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price cheap; Ratio B 0.94x; +91% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap +1.13; conservative 2yr +37%.

BEAR.desc: EPS -7.7%/yr (worst year FY11-FY20, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +37.2%/yr (Q2 2021 revenue + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +37.2%/yr (FY11-FY20 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +37.2%/yr (best 2-yr run FY11-FY20); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: UNP (retrospective, 2021-09-24) ◎ ACCUMULATE — Ratio B 0.94x (50.4% downside to Bear $101 / +53.6% upside to Bull $313) | Adj composite 3.35 vs market 2.22: gap +1.13 [UNDERVALUED] | +91% above the EPP floor $106 (13x FY21E $8.19) | Conservative 2-yr case: +36.6% total (+18.3%/yr) | At 24.9x FY21E the 15% hurdle price $270 sits at or below the BASE case; carloads +22% in Q2 2021, forward revenue +29% (no FY21 revenue guide, Q2 2021 freight revenue); no disruption theme has dated evidence.
